preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 512 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 8 and 1 <= C <= 8 and 1 <= K <= 8 for R, C, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the row R, column C, and moves K are between 1 and 8 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= result <= 64 for result in results)
postconditions.description: The number of squares the king can visit in each test case is between 1 and 64 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == count_reachable_squares(R, C, K) for (R, C, K), result in zip(test_cases, results))
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is the count of squares reachable by the king from (R, C) in at most K moves.
